text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock 206SP-C16RC1 Extra Heavy Duty Padlock 5/8" Shackle

The MUL-T-LOCK C-Series padlocks are designed to offer high security for general use. All C-Series padlocks are made of hardened steel with a Boron steel alloy shackle to withstand the most determined attempts of physical abuse. When looking for High Security Padlock Protection, MUL-T-LOCK'S C-Series line of padlocks is your answer.

MUL-T-LOCK padlocks are designed to provide high security door protection with patented key control. The Key Card owner is the only person allowed to have the keys duplicated. Remove the worry about anyone making duplicates of your keys.

Supplied standard with 1 owner key card per key combination and 2 keys per lock cylinder.

This removable shackle padlock as a protective shutter to protect the cylinder from dust contamination and a drain holes to provent freezing. 60 degree key rotation unlocks the padlock. Key retaining lock type (key needed for closing) to prevent accidental locking.

Features for Mul-T-Lock C16RC1 Extra Heavy Duty Padlock

  • Massive 5/8" Diameter Hardened Boron Alloy Shackle
  • Removable Shackle
  • Hardened Steel Body
  • Drill and Pick Resistant Cylinder
  • Bump Proof Design
  • Mul-T-Lock 206SP Security Keyway
  • MUL-T-LOCK's Patented Interactive Key Control System
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty

Specifications for Mul-T-Lock C16RC1 Extra Heavy Duty Padlock

  • Shackle Diameter: 5/8" (16mm)
  • Lock Body Height: 2-1/6" (53mm)
  • Lock Body Width: 3-5/8" (92mm)
  • Lock Body Thickness: 1-1/4" (32mm)
  • Clearance: 2" (50mm)
  • Standard Grades: "CEN" 5
  • Supplied with 2 Keys per Lock
  • MUL-T-LOCK C16RC1 Padlock Specifications Diagram (PDF)

If ordering multiple locks you can have them Key Alike (use the same key) or Keyed Different (different keys for each lock). You can also order Extra Keys Cut below if more than the standard 2 keys are required.
